project_type: Tauri desktop app: Rust crates (hybrid-orchestrator/crates/*) + React/TS webview (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/)
build_system: Cargo per-crate (the workspace has NO members; each crate under [workspace] exclude is built standalone via `cargo <cmd> --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`). Frontend: npm + vite + vitest. Tauri CLI NOT available in sandbox.
test_framework: Rust: `cargo test --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml` (secrets/providers/orchestrator-core use InMemorySecretStore; keyring-backed test is #[ignore]d - no Secret Service on headless CI). Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react with jsdom; all invoke() calls mocked in test-setup / per-test.
build_command: Per touched crate: `cargo build --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend: `cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run build` (tsc && vite build).
test_command: Per touched crate: `cargo test --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend: `cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm test` (vitest run).
verification_instructions: SANDBOX IS INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: crates.io + npm registry return 403, so `cargo build/test` and `npm install` CANNOT run here for crates with external deps (secrets pulls `keyring`; frontend needs node_modules). Real gates run in GitHub CI after push (per-crate cargo fmt --check / build / test / clippy -D warnings via --manifest-path, plus frontend eslint/tsc/vitest/prettier). Offline self-audit that IS possible: read-through review of diffs for clippy classes (unused imports/vars, needless_lifetimes, dead_code, unnecessary_lazy_evaluations, flat-prose doc comments), TS no-unused-vars, tsc-strict shape, serde field attributes, mock completeness, section-mount-order. If node_modules/cargo registry happen to be pre-populated, run the real commands; otherwise rely on static self-audit and note it. Behavioral proof of the keychain fix is the user's Windows build (add a self-test action so the build reports keychain health).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. No codegen/snapshot step.
setup_instructions: Work in /projects/agent-harbor. Start from `main` (clean, v0.8.1). Create ONE Phase-A feature branch. Spec at .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/{architecture.md,tasks.md} (repo root .kiro, NOT under hybrid-orchestrator).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: no crates.io, no npm registry, no Tauri CLI, no live Ollama/cloud endpoints, no real OS keychain. Cannot run cargo/npm/tauri builds if deps aren't cached. Do NOT push/tag/PR (orchestrator publishes). Do NOT touch the embedded-engine feature-flagging/release bundle or start the folder-scan rework. Do NOT regress v0.8.x features.
contribution_requirements: New Tauri commands must be: added to generate_handler! in crates/tauri-app/src/lib.rs, wrapped with a typed IPC helper in frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts, given a TS type, and use camelCase serde (rename_all="camelCase"). New/renamed CoreEvent/DTO fields must be mirrored in frontend/src/types/index.ts AND every mock/reducer/test. New store fields must be initialized in EVERY setState reset in tests. Whole-frontend prettier must be clean: from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .`. Per-crate `cargo fmt --check` for every touched crate.
key_patterns: SecretStore trait in crates/secrets/src/lib.rs (KeyringSecretStore for prod, InMemorySecretStore for tests); KEYCHAIN_SERVICE = com.agent-harbor.hybrid-orchestrator. Store paths set_cloud_provider_inner / set_local_runtime_inner in crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs already propagate store() errors via `?`. ChatDelta in crates/providers/src/contract.rs has optional fields with `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if=...)]`. StreamDelta parsing in crates/providers/src/adapters/native.rs::parse_stream_chunk (Ollama chats through OpenAI-compat /v1 path via NativeAdapter, NOT native /api/chat). CoreEvent in crates/orchestrator-core/src/events.rs is a serde tag="type" camelCase union; MessageStarted.text is the precedent for an optional camelCase additive field (default + skip_serializing_if). Pipeline maps ChatDelta->CoreEvent in crates/orchestrator-core/src/pipeline.rs::stream_turn. Frontend event bridge: crates/tauri-app/src/events.rs -> frontend/src/ipc/events.ts -> conversations store applyCoreEvent reducer. Composer control row: frontend/src/features/chat/Composer.tsx (web-search toggle is the exact precedent: aria-pressed + store flag webSearchEnabled/setWebSearchEnabled, initialized in the store default). MessageBubble: frontend/src/features/chat/MessageBubble.tsx. Design tokens: frontend/src/styles/{tokens.css,app.css} (harbor blue, light+dark).
directory_structure: Repo root /projects/agent-harbor: README.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/{architecture.md,tasks.md}, hybrid-orchestrator/ (Cargo workspace-with-no-members + frontend/). crates/: domain, engine, mcp-client, orchestrator-core, persistence, providers (adapters/: native, ollama, gemini, bedrock, + web_search.rs, registry.rs, contract.rs), routing, secrets, tauri-app (commands.rs ~6900 lines, lib.rs generate_handler!, state.rs builds KeyringSecretStore, events.rs bridge). frontend/src/: features/{chat,settings,model-selector,history,tool-manager,agent-editor}, state/ (zustand stores), ipc/ (commands.ts, events.ts), types/index.ts, styles/.
